meta.composition: web (dsh-base + dsh-web-app + plugin tarball via `dsh plugin add`), scratch DSH_HOME, restricted patch identical in shape to the Linux deployment
meta.scope: GUI-host rendering/RPC evidence under a scripted model endpoint; the credential broker is the live .87 service reached through a forwarded socket behind a local uid-996 front-end. This record is not deployment certification and does not cover the macOS-initiator matrix item.

artifacts.rpcCaptureNote: captured after temporarily retargeting the test profile to the local macOS broker (5-environment manifest, digest 7e2c3c91...); the profile was restored afterwards; see the 2026-11-11 review R3

deployment.manifestOwner: root:wheel 0644, every ancestor root-owned non-writable (production check, loadDeploymentManifest without test bypass)
deployment.brokerSocketChain: Host connects /private/var/run/dsh-gui/broker.sock (srw-rw---- uid996:staff, dir drwxr-s--- uid996:staff) → local relay process running as uid 996 → ssh -L TCP 18777 → .87 bridge process running as dshhost uid 1000 → /run/dsh-ssh-broker/broker.sock
deployment.credentialRoot: /private/var/lib/dsh-ssh-broker drwx------ uid 996; accessSync(R_OK) from the Host account returns EACCES
deployment.note: The attestation's kernel facts are real: socket file owned by uid 996 in a uid-996 directory with no world access, credential root unreadable from the Host uid. The broker protocol terminates on .87; SO_PEERCRED there sees the uid-1000 bridge.

attestation.result: attested — remote-tools row mounted verifier, tools and capability projection

tools.evidence: scripted model endpoint recorded the real /v1/messages request; tools array ends with remote_bash + remote_copy only while remoteEnvironments.enabled=true
tools.disabledObservation: after setting remoteEnvironments.enabled=false and restarting dsh web, the recorded tools array contains no remote_* entries; the panel renders "远端控制面不可用：disabled" while local primary/additional-root sections stay functional

panel.driver: real Chromium (Google Chrome, remote-debugging CDP), page http://127.0.0.1:3080, session view → Workspace Folders dialog
panel.initialDialog: 远端环境 section listed vps-app and vps-xfer as 未登记/当前能力：不可用 with a 登记 action

wire.addRemote: {"method":"addRemote","payload":{"sessionId":"session-c7881a16-…","environmentId":"vps-xfer","rootId":"import"}} → 200 with endpoints[] where vps-app.state=registered capabilities{read,write,exec,send:true,receive:false} and status.state=ready
wire.removeRemote: {"method":"removeRemote","payload":{"sessionId":"…","environmentId":"vps-xfer","rootId":"import"}} → vps-xfer state=unregistered, all capabilities false, reason=remote-unregistered; subsequent remotes call confirms the persisted state
wire.skillsChanges: long-poll generation channel live (20s pending responses observed)

panel.afterRegister: vps-app 已登记 当前能力：读取, 写入, 执行, 发送 / vps-xfer 已登记 当前能力：读取, 写入, 接收, 发送
panel.afterRemove: vps-xfer returns to 未登记-equivalent projection server-side (state unregistered)

conclusion: A real GUI host (DSH Web, Chromium) boots the restricted profile, passes broker attestation over a kernel-enforced uid-996 socket boundary, mounts remote_bash/remote_copy into the model-facing tool catalog, renders manifest-bound remote entries in Workspace Folders through the plugin Connection RPC, and registers/updates/revokes them over the same channel. Disabling remoteEnvironments removes all remote capability while local roots and native services keep working.
